plain_statement: Covering formula CS of a graph with k labels: variables x(v,t) (v has label t) and d(e) (the ends of e share no label); clauses: each vertex has a label; for non-adjacent u, v and each map f from labels to {u, v}, OR of x(f(t),t); for each edge uv and label t, not d(e) or not x(u,t) or not x(v,t); for each set S of k - 1 vertices, OR of d(e) over edges with no end in S. Width: largest clause of a resolution refutation, axioms counted, no weakening. Not (the least width of CS is 3 on the 5-cycle with k = 3 and 4 on two disjoint triangles with k = 4). Conjecture.
title: Probe: NOT (the covering formula CS has least resolution width 3 on the 5-cycle with 3 labels and 4 on two disjoint triangles with 4 labels)
